### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root of the nf-core/molkart results (clahe/, segmentation/, spot2cell/, molkartqc/, mindagap/, pipeline_info/), plus input/ holding the samplesheet the run was launched with (samplesheet*.csv). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV): sample id in a column named sample or in the first column, one column per factor. Enables the design filter and colouring. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design-table sample id column. Auto-detected as the first column; defaults to 'sample'. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design column the dashboards filter and colour by. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |
| `PRIMARY_SEGMENTATION` | — | Segmentation method (mesmer, cellpose, stardist or ilastik) whose labels and cells the Tissue and Cell x gene tabs show. Must be one of the run's --segmentation_method values. |
| `COMPARE_SEGMENTATION` | — | Second segmentation method, shown in the Segmentation comparison tab's viewer. Must be another of the run's --segmentation_method values. |
| `SINGLE_SEGMENTATION` | — | Set (any value) when the run used a single segmentation method: prunes the comparison viewer's collections. |
| `MEMBRANE_STACK` | — | Set (any value) when the samples carry a membrane image: the viewer then shows the 2-channel `stack/<sample>_stack.ome.tif` instead of the per-channel CLAHE images. |
| `IMAGE_SAMPLE_PATTERN` | — | Regex with one capture group giving the sample from an image file name. The default reads `<sample>_<image>_gridfilled_clahe.tiff` when the image name has no underscore or starts with the sample id, and `<sample>_stack.ome.tif`. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

(A `direct` collection can still have a recipe — one that merely parses/cleans the raw file; `derived` means the recipe reshapes another collection.)

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`mindagap/marked_spots.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/mindagap/marked_spots.py) | Mindagap duplicatefinder's marked spot tables, counted per sample and gene: | `sample`, `gene`, `status`, `spots`, `pct_of_sample` |
| [`molkartqc/spot_qc.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/molkartqc/spot_qc.py) | molkartqc's per-sample, per-segmentation QC sheet, typed, with the sample id | `sample`, `segmentation_method`, `total_cells`, `avg_area`, `total_spots`, `spot_assign_per_cell`, `spot_assign_total`, `spot_assign_percent`, `spots_unassigned`, `duplicated_total`, `duplicated_percent`, `labels_total`, `labels_below_thresh`, `labels_above_thresh`, `labels_removed_percent` |
| [`nf-core/molkart/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/molkart/recipes/samples.py) | One row per nf-core/molkart sample: the samplesheet, joined to the run's design. | `sample_id`, `nuclear_image`, `spot_table`, `membrane_image`, `has_membrane` |
| [`spot2cell/cell_genes_long.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/spot2cell/cell_genes_long.py) | spot2cell's cell-by-gene tables melted to one row per (cell, gene) with at | `sample`, `segmentation_method`, `cell_id`, `cell_key`, `gene`, `count`, `frac_of_cell` |
| [`spot2cell/cells.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/spot2cell/cells.py) | One row per segmented cell from spot2cell's cell-by-gene tables: where the cell | `sample`, `segmentation_method`, `cell_id`, `cell_key`, `x_centroid`, `y_centroid`, `area`, `major_axis_length`, `minor_axis_length`, `eccentricity`, `solidity`, `extent`, `orientation`, `total_counts`, `n_genes`, `dominant_gene`, `dominant_gene_frac` |
| [`spot2cell/gene_heatmap.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/spot2cell/gene_heatmap.py) | Genes x samples: the mean transcripts per cell of the panel's most abundant | `gene` |
| [`spot2cell/gene_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/spot2cell/gene_summary.py) | Per sample, segmentation method and gene: how many transcripts the cells hold, | `sample`, `segmentation_method`, `gene`, `total_counts`, `cells_expressing`, `n_cells`, `frac_cells_expressing`, `mean_per_cell`, `mean_per_expressing_cell`, `share_of_counts_pct`, `rank` |
